confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge, not live listings; no web sources were used for the price anchors. Remembered prices were brought forward to July 2026 for local inflation; the dinar is pegged to the US dollar. Restaurant and hostel anchors are better grounded than alcohol and hotel anchors. Cocktail (about 2x beer) and wine glass (about 1.4x beer) are derived from the beer anchor because direct bar-price knowledge is weak. Post-June 2026 security or demand shifts may have moved accommodation prices and are not reflected. FX figure comes from web search summaries citing the RBA exchange-rates page, not a direct page read.
comparable_city_reasoning: Regional basis rather than a single comparable city: Amman was placed among Levant and wider Middle Eastern capitals for local restaurant and budget lodging levels, and the three-star anchor reflects Amman's business-hotel market.
